The '''Muzzlian squill''' was a type of trinket<ref name="Tales" /> that originated in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Muzzli system/Legends|Muzzli system]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Citlik sector/Legends|Citlik sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Muzzlian squills were among the multiple types of trinket available in specialty shops in a marketplace on level five of<ref name="Tales" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']]<ref name="EAOC Dravian">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Dravian Starport system/Legends|star system]] containing [[Dravian Starport]]</ref> [[Dravian Starport]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]].<ref name="Tales" />

==Behind the scenes==
Muzzlian squills were mentioned in "[[Tales of the Smoking Blaster|Tales of the ''Smoking Blaster'']]," a [[roleplaying game]] adventure written by [[Bill Smith]]. The adventure was included in ''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Handbook]]'', a [[1993]] sourcebook published by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Tales" />
